faq.title: Common Questions
faq.q1: I need a website, where do I start?
faq.a1: Great start! Contact us and we'll analyze your idea to suggest the best platform, whether it's Salla/Zid or a custom Next.js site.
faq.q2: Does the price include hosting and domain?
faq.a2: Yes! In our premium packages, we cover domain registration and high-speed cloud hosting for the first year for free.
faq.q3: Can I request changes after delivery?
faq.a3: Absolutely! We believe in long-term partnership. We provide a support period to ensure stability and implement necessary adjustments.
faq.q4: How long does a project take?
faq.a4: We combine speed with quality. Most stores and landing pages take between 7 to 14 business days to launch.
faq.a5: Definitely! All our sites are built with the latest performance and SEO standards to ensure top rankings.
